basePrompt: Use case: illustration-story. ONE original opaque full-bleed 5:7 portrait oil painting for a medieval dark-fantasy civilization Practice card. Seek the storytelling compositional mastery of N. C. Wyeth and Dean Cornwell: one decisive action, bold silhouettes, monumental environmental scale, broad expressive visible oil brushwork, large calm color masses, and the sharpest contrast only at the action. Early twentieth-century adventure book painting, not photorealistic or glossy digital fantasy. Include two or three working human figures; all faces completely indiscernible, shown from behind, distant, or in deep shadow. Put the action, key tool or material, and principal figures in the UPPER CENTRAL 45 percent because game UI covers the lower half. The lower half is subdued and quiet. Clear at 70x100 pixels. No text, letters, symbols, decorative border, frame, interface, vignette, tiny clutter, or unrelated objects. Subject:

assets.pottery: Three cloaked potters in a cavernous clay workshop; one turns a large wet vessel on a wheel while another steadies it and a third carries finished jars. The spinning pale clay vessel is the one bright focus beneath high dark timber beams. Earth red, ivory clay, slate shadow.
assets.papermaking: Three faceless papermakers beside an enormous water vat lift one broad wet ivory sheet on a rectangular screen; water streams from its edge in a single graceful arc. The sheet is the focal plane against deep cool shadow, tall drying racks suggest the workshop scale.
assets.lensGrinding: In a shadowed high-ceiling optical workshop, one hooded craftsperson lifts a large circular glass lens to a narrow sunbeam while two others grind and polish at a bench. The lens catches a single brilliant blue-white ray, one crisp circle against broad dark architectural shapes.
assets.herbalism: Three hooded herbalists in a tall ancient garden harvest medicinal leaves into a large basket. One worker cuts a single bright green herb sprig in the upper center while another sorts broad leaves; towering stone wall and old trees dwarf them. Controlled luminous green against quiet umber.
assets.distilling: Three faceless alchemic workers tend a great copper alembic in a vast stone chamber. The focal action is one clear droplet falling from the curved spout into a blue glass flask held by the lead worker; the others turn valves in shadow. Warm brass and furnace umber, one cool blue glint.
assets.brickmaking: Three tiny clay workers press wet red clay into large rectangular wooden moulds beside rows of drying bricks. One lifts a fresh orange brick against the broad pale sky, a single strong rectangle; long kiln and fields recede. Burnt sienna, dusty ochre, quiet grey.
assets.civilEngineering: On a colossal stone bridge under construction across a deep gorge, three small hooded builders haul a keystone with rope and pulley toward the unfinished arch. The pale stone suspended over empty space is the focal instant; distant valley gives dizzying scale. Cool slate, warm rope and stone edge.
assets.roadBuilding: Three faceless road builders set one broad pale paving slab into a long causeway vanishing through wild hills. One kneels at the slab while two strain on a lever; the aligned road leads to the bright focal placement. Huge landscape and storm sky, muted green-grey and ivory.
assets.weaving: Inside a vast timber weaving hall, three hooded workers operate a great upright loom. One hand throws the shuttle across a broad crimson cloth panel, the only saturated focal color; other looms fade into dark large shapes. Strong vertical threads and horizontal red cloth plane.
assets.brewing: Three faceless brewers work around an enormous copper vat beneath a high stone roof. One lifts a ladle and a bright arc of foaming amber ale returns to the vat; two others carry grain sacks. The amber liquid is the sole focal light amid warm dark wood and slate.
assets.minting: Three hooded workers in a cavernous mint, one raises a heavy die hammer as another holds a blank gold coin on a steel anvil. The single coin and imminent strike create the focal point, tiny warm disc against broad deep-blue shadows and immense stone vault.
assets.taxAssessment: Within a tall civic counting hall, three faceless assessors seen from behind weigh a grain sack against a broad brass balance while another marks a large blank ledger. The taut scale beam and one pale sack form the focal geometry; huge stone columns and subdued crowd silhouettes show civic scale. No legible writing.
